Lab 4: Point clouds from photogrammetry and lidar

Hans Ole Ørka, 19. September 2026

Goal: Understand difference between point cloud data obtain from lidar or Airborne laser scanning (ALS) and aerial imagery/photogrammetry or Digital Aerial Photogrammetry (DAP). Learn the basic content of the LAS/LAZ format specification and how this data can be manipulated to create Digital Surface Models (DSMs), Digital Terrain Models (DTMs), and Canopy Height Models (CHMs).

Data: The data for the lab can be downloaded from the link below.

  • https://eduumb.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/team_mina305instructors/IgD5sXOG76LaTr5QUe5z6ZIhAYwWuhzsMaKkdRar_iUmWd4?e=ya2V67

Part 1: Exploring point clouds using lidR

The lab exercise is carried out using R and the lidR-package. The lidRBook is a fantastic resource!

Necessary R packages

# Load packages 
library("lidR")
library("sf")
library("terra")
library("ggplot2")
library("future")

Read and inspect laser data

Three different point clouds are provided in the folder “data/frydenhaug/”:

Filename Type p/m^2
als2008.laz lidar 1.9
als2021.laz lidar 5
dap2021.laz image 20

ALS 2008

Part 2: Create DSM, DTM and CHM

lasFile <- "data/frydenhaug/als2021.laz" # Filename
filter <- "-keep_xy 599850 6615750 600250 6616030" #Filter to only select a spesific area  
las <- readLAS(lasFile,filter=filter)

Ground classification and creation of digital terrin model

# Select ground echoes
ground <- readLAS(lasFile,filter=paste0(filter, " -keep_class 2"))
plot(ground)
x <- plot(ground,color="Intensity",colorPalette=gray.colors(20))
veg <- readLAS(lasFile,filter=paste0(filter, " -drop_class 2"))
plot(veg,add=x)

# DTM
dtm <- rasterize_terrain(las, res = 1, algorithm = tin())
x <- plot(veg)
add_dtm3d(x, dtm)
plot(dtm)


# DSM
dsm <- rasterize_canopy(las,res = 1, algorithm = dsmtin())
plot(dsm)


chm <- dsm - dtm
plot(chm)

Normalizing ALS point cloud data

lasdz <- normalize_height(las, tin())
plot(lasdz)
table(lasdz$Classification)

     1      2      7 
373957 256744   1840 
plot(lasdz,color="Classification")

Difference between 2021 and 2008

chm2021 <- chm
lasFile <- "data/frydenhaug/als2008.laz" # Filename
filter <- "-keep_xy 599850 6615750 600250 6616030" #Filter to only select a spesific area  
las <- readLAS(lasFile,filter=filter)
dtm <- rasterize_terrain(las, res = 1, algorithm = tin())
dsm <- rasterize_canopy(las,res = 1, algorithm = dsmtin())
chm2008 <- dsm - dtm
diff <- chm2021 - chm2008
plot(diff)

chm2021 <- chm
lasFile <- "data/frydenhaug/dap2021.laz" # Filename
filter <- "-keep_xy 599850 6615750 600250 6616030" #Filter to only select a spesific area  
dap <- readLAS(lasFile,filter=filter)
